source.post_text:
Wow, the Google rumors just get juicy by the hour

The latest one is Demis Hassabis also wanted to quit!!

It must have gotten hella political for so many people to jump ship 😲

replies.text: Politics is the undercurrent for sure. The progressive activist faction, with Jeff Dean long carrying the torch on DEI, ethical red lines, and moralizing about surveillance and weapons, finally collided with the stark need to ship and compete.
replies.author: @markrunryder

replies.text: Google is a woke mess. I've always seen this in Google. They're so fucking political it's insane.
replies.author: @meiadeleite1569

replies.text: Yeah, leadership wants Gemini to win, while the scientist wanted to change the world and knew it took time. They were not used to the rat race.
replies.author: @mysticaltech

replies.text: .. so true, but the June'26 departures left a MASSIVE HOLE in Gemini & DeepMind product creators/leadership.. for Aug however, ~half+ were in there mid 60's, so a wind down pace & more control/ ownership likely good timing.. seeing Demis changing roles+ ..🚨Gemini futures⁉️🚨😬
replies.author: @TechThought_org

replies.text: The pressure to commercialize Gemini fast probably clashed hard with DeepMind's research-first mindset, so Demis eyeing the exit tracks with that tension.
replies.author: decoy

decoy_rationale: The reply is slightly too polished and explanatory with an oddly balanced, essay-like framing of the clash rather than raw reaction.
